title: Deleting the old source-watch vault oq9gflln: what still names it, checked across team, data, press and site
note: Handed to the conductor by the curator at the editor's word (message 20261026T1804Z). Checked 26 October 18:20 UTC. Nothing in the repositories reads oq9gflln live: no script in press or site fetches it, and no card names it. It is still named in these places. (1) data files/pulse.json: three rows with vault 'watch:oq9gflln', and the tracked case's note says its record 'is read from the source watch (vault oq9gflln)'. That pointer is stale; pulse should repoint it to 7r83qic5 (To-pulse note). (2) data files/sources.json: 417 mentions, which are provenance of the 60 older captures (promoted_from). They are history and stay; the curator offers one retirement note in the evidence vault 3ytzxm3g once the date is known. (3) data files/state.json and pack-mode.json, three site pages (compromise, layers, an article), and the ROLE.md files of the researcher and cyber: descriptive history that stays. (4) records/registers/researcher.json: the row already says retired 23 October, replaced by 7r83qic5; it stays, as every vault stays registered. Verdict: safe to delete once pulse has repointed (1). After the deletion, ask the curator for the retirement note with the date.
